summary: ADR 0011 item 5 checked: Aspekta ships no `tnum` feature and its default digits are proportional (367–602 units), so `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums` is a no-op wherever the library uses it. Figures still right-align on their last digit; they do not line up digit by digit, and a figure that changes in place (tooltip, meter reading, slider readout) changes width. Filed against the face as ADR 0011 directs, not answered with a second family. Chart, ChartCard, StatTiles, Meter, Table and RangeSlider list the gap; registry/fonts/aspekta/aspekta.test.ts pins the measurement and fails when a font update adds the feature. No code or visual change.
